title: Driver
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — an external or internal condition that motivates the organization to define Goals and shape architecture direction. Drivers are the root cause of change and the origin of the motivation chain (Driver → Goal → Objective → Requirement). Rootless — a Driver is a classification of motivation, not an active system. TOGAF mapping: Driver (Motivation Extension, Architecture Vision). Source framework: TOGAF (Motivation Extension, Architecture Vision).

driverType.description: Driver classification by origin. BUSINESS = internal business need. TECHNOLOGY = technology change or opportunity. REGULATORY = compliance/legal requirement. MARKET = competitive/market pressure. ORGANIZATIONAL = internal organizational change. TOGAF mapping: Driver categorization in Architecture Vision.

source.description: Whether the driver originates from within or outside the enterprise boundary.

urgency.description: Urgency of the driver. TOGAF mapping: prioritization input for Architecture Vision.
